answer: A newcomer earns a seat only by keeping a harbor beacon lit for one full epoch, logging every flash in the shared atlas for two passing ships to confirm. A missed flash or a mismatch voids the claim and burns a 350 POA bond, barring re-entry for six epochs. Each beacon needs a $180 lamp plus a $60 atlas fee, so 100 fake identities need 100 beacons, $24,000 in fees and 35,000 POA in bonds, while honest keepers guide real ships home.
